name: nn-swift-skills
description: API reference skills for Nikolai Nobadi's public Swift packages. Each skill lives in the package repo it documents, so the API and its docs change together.

plugins.name: SwiftPickerKit
plugins.description: SwiftPickerKit Swift API reference for terminal-based interactive pickers with single/multi-selection, two-column layouts, tree navigation, and file system browsing.

plugins.name: NnArgumentParser
plugins.description: NnArgumentParser Swift API reference for building testable command-line tools on top of Apple's ArgumentParser — the NnRootCommand protocol with a contextFactory dependency-injection seam, InteractionMode for suppressing prompts in automated contexts, and the testRun helper for driving commands end-to-end in tests.

plugins.name: NnTesting
plugins.description: Swift testing plugin — NnTestKit API reference and unit test workflow engine for iOS/macOS projects.

plugins.name: NnShellKit
plugins.description: NnShellKit Swift API reference for shell command execution from Swift with protocol-based design, timeout support, and MockShell testing utilities.

plugins.name: NnFileKit
plugins.description: NnFileKit Swift API reference for file system access from Swift with protocol-based FileSystem/Directory design, a FileManager-backed DefaultFileSystem, and MockFileSystem/MockDirectory testing utilities.

plugins.name: NnReminderKit
plugins.description: NnReminderKit Swift API reference for local notification scheduling and management on Apple platforms.

plugins.name: NnSwiftUIKit
plugins.description: NnSwiftUIKit Swift API reference — reusable SwiftUI components, error handling, font system, and view modifiers for iOS/macOS/watchOS.

plugins.name: NnVersionKit
plugins.description: NnVersionKit Swift API reference for app version checking and update prompts. USE WHEN checking app version, forced update UI, checkingAppVersion view modifier, VersionUpdatePolicy, forcing updates by version range, update available status, VersionUpdateStatus, onStatus callback, UI test version seeding, StaticVersionLoader, VersionLoader, AppStoreVersionLoader, DeviceBundleVersionLoader, VersionNumber comparison, App Store version lookup, VersionKitError.

plugins.name: ConsoleProgressKit
plugins.description: ConsoleProgressKit Swift API reference for showing progress in command-line tools — live spinners, progress bars, and plain log lines on stderr. USE WHEN using ConsoleProgressKit, ProgressDisplay, LiveProgressDisplay, PlainProgressDisplay, ActivityHandle, track(_:operation:), NoteStyle, TerminalCapabilities, OR adding spinners, progress bars, or progress output to a Swift CLI.

plugins.name: nn-cli-architecture
plugins.description: Architecture reference for Swift command-line tools built on NnArgumentParser: root command and factory, the NnWorkflow inspect/collect/resolve pipeline, folder layout, file style, and workflows for a new CLI, for adding a command, and for reviewing an existing tool.
